title: Docker template rendering omits the required version
reasoning: Configuration explicitly requires a version because Docker templates use {{ version }}, but get_docker_file passes only base_image to Jinja. The base implementation silently renders version as an empty string, producing an invalid installation command or installing an unintended unpinned version despite valid configuration.
reproduction: Create a valid AgentConfigBase with a nonempty version and a Docker template containing {{ version }}. Call get_docker_file; the configured version is absent from the rendered output.
recommendation: Include version=self.version in the Docker template context and reject undefined template variables instead of silently rendering them empty.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The supplied registry tests validate registration and type matching but never render Docker templates.
suggestedRegressionTest: Extend configuration coverage to verify that validated template inputs reach rendered Docker instructions and that undeclared variables fail clearly.
